label_rule: Labels are decided from the images themselves (full resolution when unsure). episode.json and loop logs are compared afterwards; every disagreement goes to disagreements.tsv with both values and the evidence.

plate_rule_OD10.DEFECT: brick with tape, or not 2x2 -> green plate

episode_record_fields.source_path: absolute laptop path of the episode folder or log
episode_record_fields.session: any_1731 | any_1740 | grasp_auto | depth | estop | other

bricks_involved.hue_class: red | orange | yellow | green | blue | white | cream | brown | black | other
bricks_involved.size_class: small (2x2 or smaller footprint) | large (2x4 or bigger) | unknown

episode_record_fields.target_brick_index: index into bricks_involved of the brick picked, or null
episode_record_fields.outcome: success | approach_fail | grasp_fail | estop | stopped | carry_over
episode_record_fields.failure_category: none | mis_aim | jaw_contact_or_slip | wrong_brick | detector_mislabel | hand_or_person_estop | operator_stop | carry_over_from_previous | other (say what in notes)
episode_record_fields.decision_made: blue | green | none (plate the loop chose)
episode_record_fields.notes: evidence: file and frame or time

image_record_fields.kind: pre | stage1 | grasp_open | closed | lifted | released | station | crop | estop | depth | composite | other (sort-episode top/close/wrist views are kind pre/stage1/grasp_open/closed/lifted/released/station with the camera named in shows; servo and probe frames are other)
image_record_fields.shows: one-line description of what is in the image
image_record_fields.brick: colour name of the brick the image is about, or none | unclear
image_record_fields.reason: why yes or no, e.g. wrong brick in crop, jaws or cable in view

metrics_json.metrics: loop decision accuracy by OD-10, counts, label confidence distribution
